'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I came across some interesting devices recently. The first one is clearly a storage unit, and the second appears to be an RFID reader. Nothing like this has ever been seen in Tarkov before. Most likely, they're either from new shipments that bypassed the usual channels, or they were recovered from a sealed storage facility. Either way, both options won't stay available for long, so deliver one of each device to my people. Don't bring them directly to me - it's too risky while we don't know where these devices came from.}}

==Objectives==
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: 1 [[UHF RFID Reader]]
* Find the item [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]: 1 [[VPX Flash Storage Module]]
* Hand over the [[UHF RFID Reader|item]]
* Hand over the [[VPX Flash Storage Module|item]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Tech manual]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Magazine case]] at [[Mechanic]] LL3
{{quote|My people confirmed they received the devices. Thank you!}}
